newsitem.title: USA: VideoLabs posts first Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: VideoLabs posts first Q1 profit.

text.p: VideoLabs Inc said Wednesday improved sales, gross margins and cost controls gave the company its first ever first-quarter operating profit, but cautioned that future results may be unpredictable.

VideoLabs said the first quarter is generally its worst of the year and has never been profitable. The company reported first quarter earnings of $0.01 a share including a $11,350 loss on the sale of assets, versus a loss of $0.06.

The company said it focused on professional markets sales and de-emphasized sales to highly competitive retail markets, where it posted declines. Gross profit rose to 41 percent from 33 percent. In addition, selling, general and administration costs fell to $607,157 from $695,004 last year.

"We are hopeful and expect that our performance will continue to improve during the year but caution that our long- term success will be a function of new products that are currently in development for late 1997 delivery and our ability to identify new niche markets for image capture solutions," acting president and chief executive James Hansen said in a statement.
"These efforts may cause our quarter-to-quarter performance for the next several quarters to be unpredictable."
